subject: AnalyticsCo: request for committed volume discount / custom pricing
messages:
From: Jasmin Patel <jasmin@analyticsco.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: contracts@analyticsco.com
Date: 2026-09-14T15:02:00-07:00
Subject: Pricing for high-volume hosted API (tokens) – AnalyticsCo use case

Hi Karthik,

Thanks for the demo this morning. AnalyticsCo is excited about switching our inference layer to Redwood for production — the latency and cost profile looked great. Before we schedule engineering onboarding, procurement asked me to surface a few pricing questions so we can finalize the PO: 

- We expect to run ~900M–1.2B generated tokens/month by Q1 with a bursty pattern.
- We're interested in a committed monthly token tier + overage pricing. Our CFO is pushing for a blended per-token rate that is below the public rate card for committed volumes.
- Target contract length: 12–24 months; target ARR ~ $180k–$240k depending on rebate.

Can Redwood offer a custom per-token band for a committed tier (e.g., below standard rate card slabs)? If so, what approval process and timelines are required? Attached is our projected token ramp (analyticsco_usage_forecast_q4.xlsx).

Would like to have a mutual action plan and a tight turnaround — procurement is aiming to sign the MPA by end of September.

Thanks — Jasmin
Jasmin Patel
VP Product, AnalyticsCo
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Jasmin Patel <jasmin@analyticsco.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-15T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pricing for high-volume hosted API (tokens) – AnalyticsCo use case

Hi Jasmin — really appreciate the forecast and the clear targets. Quick responses to your bullets and then a suggested next step: 

- Yes, we support committed token tiers with blended per-token pricing. Our standard rate card covers up to specified bands; custom exceptions are handled by our commercial approvals (requires Sales + Revenue Ops + Finance signoff for material discounts).
- Typical timeline: 3–5 business days for an internal review once we have an official forecast + the desired committed monthly token number and contract length.
- For a 12–24 month commit at ~1B tokens/month, I’ll need to escalate for a pricing exception. I’m looping in Marissa (Head of Sales Ops) and Michael (Finance) to start that review.

Proposed mutual action plan:
1) AnalyticsCo confirms committed M tokens/month and term (please fill in the attached forecast).
2) Redwood builds a pricing exception worksheet and initial offer.
3) If approved by Finance, we share a redline-ready MPA (DocuSign).
4) Target: sign within 10 business days of offer.

Marissa/Michael — attaching the forecast Jasmin sent. Can we start an exception evaluation? Initial ask: committed 1B tokens/month, 12 months, target blended rate below published Tier 3 (please propose what floor we can work to).

Karthik
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.ai>, Jasmin Patel <jasmin@analyticsco.com>
Date: 2026-09-16T11:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pricing for high-volume hosted API (tokens) – AnalyticsCo use case

Thanks Karthik — reviewed the forecast. Quick notes: 

- AnalyticsCo profile: strong product-led adoption; likely low churn risk. The forecast shows predictable ramp to ~1B tokens/month by month 3.
- Given the strategic value (large monthly volume, potential multi-year relationship), I'm comfortable recommending a material pricing concession, but Finance must sign off on the final banding and SLA credits.

Recommendation for escalation package (what I will submit to Finance):
- Commit: 12 months at 1B tokens/month (with standard overage bands).
- Proposed commercial: 18% off published Tier 3 per-token rates for committed usage, 0–10% overage premium depending on burst pattern.
- Add-on: 30-day onboarding credit and 30-day rolling usage review to avoid quality regressions.

Attached: discount_approval_form.pdf that I'll populate and route. Michael — please advise if 18% is acceptable as a starting point or if we should floor at 15%. Also flag any contract clauses you require (SLA credits, data residency notes).

Jasmin — if that's in the ballpark, we can formalize and push a redline MPA to your contracts team.

—Marissa
Head of Sales Ops | Redwood Inference
From: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jasmin Patel <jasmin@analyticsco.com>
Date: 2026-09-20T10:37:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pricing for high-volume hosted API (tokens) – AnalyticsCo use case

Marissa / Karthik — reviewed the package and the attached forecast. Finance position: we can approve a custom pricing exception with the following conditions: 

- Approved discount: 18% off published Tier 3 per-token rate for committed usage at 1B tokens/month, 12-month minimum term.
- Overage: billed at published Tier 3 rates (no additional premium), but any sustained over-usage >1.25B tokens/month for two consecutive months triggers a re-evaluation (may require uptiering).
- Contractual conditions: 30-day onboarding credit as proposed; require a signed MPA with standard SLA credit language and a 60-day invoice net term.
- Approval contingent on Legal & Revenue Ops clearance of the redlines and an executed DocuSign envelope.

Karthik — please proceed to prepare the redline MPA. I’m okay for Sales to offer 18% as the initial committed-band discount. Forward the DocuSign link when ready and copy Finance for final verification.

Michael Grant
Director, Finance | Redwood Inference
